Hidden Base (posted under 'Other') is the Objective. Starting cards as marked: Rendezvous Point, Wise Advice, Do, Or Do Not, Your Insight Serves You Well and Heading For The Medical Frigate; several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty. Total 60 as published (section counts match).

Posted 'Obiwan EPP' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Luke EPP' Luke With Lightsaber; 'Boussh' Boushh; 'What're you Trying to Push?' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'Xwing x14' X-wing; 'Lando In Millenium Falcon' Lando In Millennium Falcon; Wise Advice is the Dagobah Effect (not the Reflections III shield); 'Forest' the generic Light site.
The 1/2001 updates list later revisions (e.g. Projection Of A Skywalker x2 out, Transmission Terminated x2 in); not applied to the list.
player_note: The post (15 October 2000) says: 'This is the LS deck I used at DecipherCon 2000', and its 1/6/2001 update says 'The deck had, since Worlds, undergone some heavy revisions' (listed in the text, not in the list). The hub records that Chu was 5–2 going into game 8 when a check removed him, and that Chu later said he had a 59-card list.
